messages:
lucy: Heads up — multiple customers reported SCIM failures and RBAC oddities after last night's KMS rotate.
omar: what errors are we seeing? any 403s or audit denials?
lucy: SCIM create/update returning 403. Our SAML consumer logs show KMS unwrap failing with INVALID_CONTEXT. Okta events include an encrypted attribute header mismatch.
trinh: do we have a sample JWE header? can we repro locally?
lucy: redacted JWE header from the assertion:
```
{\"alg\":\"RSA-OAEP\",\"enc\":\"A256GCM\",\"kid\":\"projects/global/cryptoKeys/ri-key-v3\",\"nonce\":\"X_-fQ--\"}
```
omar: that nonce looks base64url (hyphen/underscore). our decrypt path expects std-base64. if the IdP lib switched to urlsafe we've got a context mismatch and KMS rejects.
sre-oncall: KMS audit: surge of INVALID_CONTEXT for ri-key-v3 starting 2026-04-03T02:05Z (~1.1k events).
trinh: mitigation options: 1) make decrypt tolerant (try urlsafe, then std) behind a feature flag; 2) requeue failed SCIM events and reconcile orphans; 3) vendor coordination to fix generator.
omar: short-term tolerant decode seems safest. add a metric saml.decrypt_context_fallback_count and log a 8-byte hex prefix for correlation. keep feature flag off until staging verified.
lucy: agreed. I'll open a tiny PR to add parseNonce(n) -> try base64url decode, fallback to std. gating via flag and adding unit vectors. also adding a reconciler job to detect "created_local && not_provisioned_remote" service accounts and mark for retry/manual cleanup.
sre-oncall: i'll watch INVALID_CONTEXT, scim_retry_backlog, and orphan_account_gauge for the deploy window. also extend audit log retention for KMS entries in the incident window for postmortem.
trinh: quick vuln triage: ensure relaxing decoding doesn't change auth surface. we're only decoding non-secret metadata used as KMS context; still validate length and entropy and rate-limit malformed attempts.
omar: also double-check RBAC side-effects: partial provisioning left some accounts with default roles. create a small script to find accounts created during 02:00-02:30Z and flag elevated perms for manual review.
okta-bot: Incident 2026-04-03-19 created: SCIM provisioning + KMS context mismatches — Okta team notified.
lucy: timeline: 1) PR behind flag -> staging, 2) reproduce against customer staging, 3) flip flag in staging -> verify metrics drop, 4) phased prod rollout, 5) reconcile orphans and review RBAC, 6) vendor follow-up and add regression test in our SAML e2e harness.
sre-oncall: i'll reserve a deploy window and escalate if scim backlog > 50.
trinh: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4177 (tests + metric + reconciler stub). tagging eng-security for review.
lucy: thanks team. i'll draft a short customer note and attach KMS audit export and orphan list to the incident. :thumbsup
